# Causey

> Strategic planning software for nonprofits. Turn your strategic plan into daily action — track goals, automate updates, and show your board real progress.

Causey is built for nonprofit leaders who need their strategic plan to drive daily work, not collect dust. The platform connects qualitative goals to quantitative metrics, automates the team check-in cadence, and produces board/funder-ready reports.

Markdown versions of every page are available at `/path/index.md` (URL-suffix convention per llmstxt.org). The site also publishes structured agent skills at `/.well-known/agent-skills/index.json` and an API catalog at `/.well-known/api-catalog`.

## Core pages

- [Home](/index.md): Strategic planning software for nonprofits.
- [About Causey](/about/index.md): Built by a team with 25+ years of nonprofit strategic planning experience.
- [Pricing](/pricing/index.md): Transparent tiers with unlimited users — Basic, Lite, Core, Solid.
- [Causey Basic](/causey-basic-tier/index.md): The entry tier ($30/month) for solo planners.
- [Boost](/boost/index.md): Boost packages for accelerated implementation.
- [Brand Assets](/brand-assets/index.md): Logos, colors, brand kit for partners.
- [Contact Us](/contact/index.md): Get in touch with the Causey team.
- [Privacy Policy](/privacy/index.md): How Causey handles your data.
- [Terms](/terms/index.md): Terms of service.
